Original 19th-century Shelta version:

Da's e'y know's brogues,
Da's i' Nam'n.
Da's k'nig'n come,
Da's will be da'n,
As i' hof'n, i' Nam'n, i' k'nig'n.
Gi' us this day u' dail,
As i' hof'n, i' Nam'n, i' k'nig'n,
Lea' us da' dale,
As we lea' da'nes dale.
Don't bring us in tentation,
But deli' us fra' evil,
For iver, i' Nam'n, i' k'nig'n, i' pow'r. Amen."
